- Utterson is admitted by Poole and received into Jekyll's cabinet.（Mr. Utterson、Poole、Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson asks Jekyll whether he has heard the news.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll swears he will never set eyes on Hyde again.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll gives Utterson a letter signed Edward Hyde to judge.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll says he burned the envelope and it bore no postmark.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll admits Hyde dictated the terms of his will.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Poole tells Utterson no letter came except by post.（Mr. Utterson、Poole）
- Utterson hears newsboys crying the murder of an M.P.（Mr. Utterson）
- Utterson shows Guest the murderer's autograph letter.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Guest）
- Guest compares the letter with Jekyll's note and finds them identical.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Guest）
- Utterson locks the note in his safe and suspects Jekyll of forgery.（Mr. Utterson）
